title: Solutions to some open problems in matrix analysis
summary: We solve a problem posed by Audenaert and Kittaneh in 2012 by proving that the Aujla--Bourin subadditivity inequality can be strengthened to an optimal form. We also answer questions posed by Bourin and the second author: (1) we significantly extend both the reciprocal Lie--Trotter theorem of Audenaert and Hiai and Kato's limit theorem; (2) we determine the best constants in inequalities for sums of contractions and positive block matrices, including the sharp triangle inequality $$ |A+B+C| \leq \frac{3}{4} I + |A|+|B|+|C| $$ for three contractions $A,B,C$; and (3) we prove a remarkable…
